verdict.rationale: VPM documents on-request opening and scanning of mail for online access, with a stated turnaround of usually within 6 business hours, which beats the same/next-business-day bar. Registered-agent legal documents are scanned the same day they arrive and stored as PDFs, and general mail can be tagged to make it easier to find. Missing for 10: evidence that scans are searchable (OCR'd) PDFs, confirmation that general mailbox scans (not just registered-agent documents) are delivered as PDFs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the turnaround.
